about: Abdulla Bin Khater Foodstuff LLC (ABK FOODSTUFF LLC) is the absolute source for all your Fresh Vegetables. Abdulla Bin Khater Foodstuff LLC (ABK FOODSTUFF LLC) has become a name synonymous with quality supplier of fresh vegetables produce. We have built and maintained this reputation across the UAE for over 3 decades.

We Import high quality fresh vegetables all sourced from across the globe including Holland, Spain, China, Malaysia, India, Jordon. We have HASSAP approved cold storage facility in Dubai to store large scale bulk quantity of all type of Vegetables. A fleet of modern refrigerated vehicles complements our facilities and ensures absolute freshness at the point of delivery.
